_doc: Registry of the DuckPeng project (DuckPeng, master index). A SUBSET of repo_master/repos.json (git-repos-master), narrowed to DuckPeng project (the CG hub and the cloud hub). Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container - see clone.sh for the clone/link model. Private members are linked only: the index exposes their name, never their content.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.

repos.name: CG
repos.doc: Project master for the CG family (CG-circus, CG-galaxy, CG-galaxy-gaia, CG-unity, CG-voxel-rust): its own repos.json subset plus committed symlinks, same model as front, cloud and lecole-42. Created 2026-10-26 (#1204).

repos.name: cloud
repos.doc: Project master for the cloud project: a repos.json subset of this file plus committed symlinks. Had a symlink here but no entry until 2026-08-20 — the drift that made `ls a_cloud/` disagree with `--list`.

_root_doc: No entries carry a group field - every member links at the root of this index, same as CG and front.
